parallels.note: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

translations.web: They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
translations.bsb: They kept striking His head with a staff and spitting on Him. And they knelt down and bowed before Him.
translations.kjv: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
translations.asv: And they smote his head with a reed, and spat upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
